ask-hicp-2024.title: IHÇK, Dhjetor 2024, tabela 1 dhe 2
ask-hicp-2024.methodology: Official HICP with Lowe-type aggregation and expenditure weights; use the fixed 2024 publication, not conflicting current API base notes.
ask-hicp-2024.revisions: Snapshot is a pinned vintage; later releases may revise it. API updated fields are not treated as publication dates.
ask-hicp-2024.limitations: Two production sectors do not map to twelve COICOP expenditure divisions. Weights vary by year; do not recreate an official chain index by averaging fixed-base levels.

ask-wages.title: Average Salary in Kosovo (Gross/Net), PxWeb tab01
ask-wages.methodology: Annual average monthly employee salary. Public payroll administrative source; 2024 private/POE data from tax administration, previous years from business register (table notes).
ask-wages.revisions: Snapshot is a pinned vintage; later releases may revise it. API updated fields are not treated as publication dates.
ask-wages.limitations: 2024 source break; employees only, not disposable household income. Gross and net must remain separate.
ask-wages.license: ASK PxWeb pages state Copyright: No; retain attribution and snapshot provenance.

ask-labour.title: Main labor market indicators (%), PxWeb tab1b
ask-labour.methodology: Labour Force Survey, total sex, ages 15-64. Unemployment is a share of labour force; employment rate and participation use working-age population.
ask-labour.revisions: Snapshot is a pinned vintage; later releases may revise it. API updated fields are not treated as publication dates.
ask-labour.limitations: Survey/revision and demographic denominator changes must be reviewed; employment rate is not 100 minus unemployment.
